activity_summary: Tilney had the book open and a pen in red ink on the leaf. The prose line was the line on that page. His men were stitching masquing cloth for Sunday's wedding. Your hands were empty.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited, and did not lean over the page.

entities.name: Edmund Tilney
entities.context: Read with the pen in his hand.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
